reviewer: Codex visual inspection of rendered image and requested detail crops

criteria.evidence: Membrane strokes follow the wing fingers, smaller curved marks follow the torso and neck, and horizontal marks build the landscape.
Distant hills are lighter and less detailed than the foreground vegetation; reduced weave no longer dominates the canvas.

strengths: Broken directional marks describe membrane, scales and clouds; the lighter distance and darker foreground remain coherent.
weaknesses: Hill silhouettes remain mathematically smooth, and the dragon head and feet still have a cut-paper quality. This is an oil-inspired illustration rather than a convincing traditional oil study.
